title: Paul and Denise Poiret: The rise and fall of a trailblazing couple
subhead: 'Sewn and torn' (2/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. The flamboyant couturier’s love at first sight for his discreet muse sparked a genuine aesthetic revolution at the dawn of the 20th century. Although the couple did not survive the financial hardships of the 1920s, Denise remained fiercely loyal to the memory of the fallen designer.

title: Sylvia Plath's lost novel
subhead: In 1962, Sylvia Plath began writing her second novel, one that she discussed with those close to her. But the manuscript went missing after her death, and has never been found since.

title: Alexander McQueen and Isabella Blow: Fashion, friendship and tragedy
subhead: 'Sewn and torn' (1/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. In the mid-1990s, an almost symbiotic relationship developed between the London-born designer from a working-class background and the broke aristocratic fashion journalist. That bond shattered when McQueen left for Givenchy, marking the end of their closeness – something neither ever truly recovered from.
